q: How much is a check-up and clean?
alt: how much for a dental exam
a: A **check-up and clean** is **$199** for new patients (exam, scale & clean, two bitewing x-rays) and **$169** for returning patients. Most health funds cover a large part of it — we claim on the spot with HICAPS.

q: How much does teeth whitening cost?
a: We offer two options: **in-chair whitening** for **$549** (about 90 minutes, results the same day) and **take-home trays** for **$349** (custom trays plus two weeks of gel). We'll check your teeth and gums first to make sure whitening is safe for you.

q: How much are clear aligners or Invisalign?
a: Clear aligner treatment starts from **$4,900** for minor cases and is typically **$6,500–$8,200** for full treatment. The first **aligner consult is free** and includes a 3D scan so you can preview your new smile. Interest-free payment plans are available.

q: How much is a dental implant?
a: A single **implant with crown** starts from **$4,800**, including the surgical placement, abutment and crown. Your dentist will confirm the exact cost after a consult and 3D scan ($120, deducted if you go ahead).

q: How much is a crown or filling?
a: Tooth-coloured **fillings** are **$180–$320** depending on size. **Ceramic crowns** are **$1,650** and **porcelain veneers** are **$1,450 per tooth**. You'll always get a written quote before any treatment starts.

q: How much does it cost for children?
a: We **bulk-bill eligible children** under the Child Dental Benefits Schedule (CDBS), so most kids' check-ups cost **$0**. Without CDBS, a children's check-up is **$95**. Our kids' sessions are short, gentle and come with a sticker.

q: Do you have a membership or care plan?
a: Yes — the **Tidewell Care Plan** is **$29/month** (or $299/year). It covers two check-ups and cleans, x-rays, one emergency exam, and **15% off** all other treatment. It's a good option if you don't have private health insurance.

q: Do you offer payment plans?
a: Yes. For treatment over **$1,000** we offer **interest-free plans** over 6–18 months, and **Afterpay** for amounts up to $2,000. Just ask at reception or mention it when you book.

q: What payment methods do you accept?
a: We accept **Visa, Mastercard, Amex, EFTPOS, Apple Pay and Google Pay**, plus cash. Payment is due on the day of treatment unless you're on a payment plan.

q: Do you accept my health insurance?
a: We accept **all major health funds** — Bupa, Medibank, HCF, nib, ahm and more — and claim instantly with **HICAPS**, so you only pay the gap. We're not a preferred provider for any one fund, so you're free to choose us whatever your cover.

q: What are your opening hours?
a:
Our hours are:
**Mon–Wed, Fri:** 8:00am – 6:00pm
**Thursday:** 8:00am – 8:00pm (late night)
**Saturday:** 9:00am – 2:00pm
**Sunday & public holidays:** closed

q: Are you open on weekends or after work?
a: We're open **Saturdays 9am–2pm** and until **8pm on Thursdays** for after-work appointments. We're closed on Sundays. Saturday slots go fast, so book a week or two ahead.

q: Are you open on public holidays or over Christmas?
a: We're **closed on public holidays**. Over summer we close from **24 Dec to 2 Jan**. For a dental emergency while we're closed, call the Royal Dental Hospital of Melbourne on **(03) 9341 1000**.

q: How do I book an appointment?
a: You can book right here in the chat — pick a time below — or call us on **(03) 9123 4567**. New patients should allow **60 minutes** for the first visit.

q: How do I change or cancel my appointment?
a: Use the link in your confirmation SMS, or call us on **(03) 9123 4567**. We ask for **24 hours' notice** — late cancellations and no-shows may be charged a **$60 fee**.

q: What is your cancellation policy?
a: Please give us **24 hours' notice** if you need to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations and no-shows may be charged **$60**, which we waive the first time and for genuine emergencies.

q: What happens at my first visit?
a: Your first visit takes about **60 minutes**: a full exam, x-rays, a scale & clean and a chat about any goals or worries. Please bring your **health fund card**, a list of medications and arrive 10 minutes early — or fill in our forms online beforehand.

q: How soon can I get an appointment?
a: We usually have check-up slots **within 3–5 days**, and we keep **same-day slots** free every morning for urgent problems. Pick a time below to see what's open.

q: I have a toothache or dental emergency
a: Sorry you're in pain. Please **call us now on (03) 9123 4567** — we keep same-day emergency slots every morning. Emergency exams are **$95**. If you have **swelling that affects breathing or swallowing**, go to your nearest emergency department or call **000**.

q: Where are you located?
a: We're at **214 Sydney Road, Brunswick VIC 3056**, between Albert and Victoria Streets — look for the blue door next to the bakery.

q: Is there parking or public transport nearby?
a: There's **free 2-hour parking** on Ballarat Street behind the clinic. The **19 tram** stops right outside (stop 21), and **Jewell Station** is a 4-minute walk. There's also a bike rack by the door.

q: Is the clinic wheelchair accessible?
a: Yes — the clinic is **step-free** from the street, with a wide door, an accessible toilet and one treatment room with extra space for wheelchairs and prams. Let us know when you book and we'll put you in that room.

q: I'm nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
a: You're not alone, and we'll go at your pace. We offer longer **"slow start" appointments**, noise-cancelling headphones, a stop signal you control, and **happy gas** (nitrous oxide, $120). Tell us how you feel when you book and we'll plan around it.

q: What services do you offer?
a: We offer **check-ups & cleans**, **children's dentistry**, **whitening**, **clear aligners**, **fillings, crowns & veneers**, **implants** and **same-day emergency care**. Our dentists also treat gum disease and grinding (night guards from $450).

q: Do you make night guards for teeth grinding?
a: Yes. Custom **night guards** are **$450** and **sports mouthguards** are **$220** (in team colours). Both take two short visits — one scan and one fitting.

q: Do you remove wisdom teeth?
a: We remove most **simple and surgical wisdom teeth** in the clinic, from **$290 per tooth**. Complex cases that need general anaesthetic are referred to a trusted oral surgeon nearby. An OPG x-ray ($95) comes first.

q: Who are your dentists?
a: Our team is **Dr Maya Chen** (general & cosmetic), **Dr Tom Okafor** (implants & oral surgery), **Dr Priya Nair** (children & anxious patients) and hygienist **Lena Brooks**. You can request any dentist when you book.

q: Do your dentists speak other languages?
a: Yes — our team speaks **English, Mandarin, Cantonese, Hindi, Malayalam and Greek**. We can also book a free phone interpreter through TIS National.

q: How do you keep the clinic clean and safe?
a: We follow the **Australian Dental Association infection control guidelines**: every instrument is sterilised and tracked, rooms are fully wiped down between patients, and we use single-use items wherever possible.

q: Are dental x-rays safe?
a: Our **digital x-rays** use very low radiation — about the same as a short flight. We only take them when needed. If you're **pregnant**, tell us and we'll postpone non-urgent x-rays.

q: Do I need a referral?
a: No referral is needed — you can book with us directly. If you've been referred by another dentist, bring the letter or ask them to email it to us.

q: Will I get a reminder before my appointment?
a: Yes — we send an **SMS and email reminder 2 days before** and a short SMS on the morning of your visit. We'll also remind you when your next 6-monthly check-up is due.

q: Do you sell gift cards?
a: We do — **digital gift cards** from $50, valid for 3 years and usable for any treatment (whitening is a popular one). Ask at reception or request one through the team.

q: How can I contact you?
a: Call **(03) 9123 4567** (during opening hours) or email **hello@tidewell.example**. We reply to emails within one business day — or ask me to pass a message to the team.
